title: Certify the minimum 139-row integer P112 demand subfamily (no κ)
body:

All103 previously unresolved labels are resolved. Every retained row has a full14-integer point satisfying all279 other original rows and violating that row, forcing every equivalent original-row subfamily to contain all139.

The completeness bridge is a proof, not an assumed search box: violating target(I,d) forces its inside total<=d-1<=7; setting outside coordinates8 satisfies every row with an outside bit. Proper-subset originals are the only remaining premises. Full weak-composition exhaustion and strict-support induction justify simultaneous old/new deletion.
